assets.brief: Open-sided 4m x 6m Nigerian street suya canopy frame, modular steel poles, practical joints and real-world scale. No baked scene floor or unrelated props.
Separate striped red-and-cream weathered canopy fabric mesh sized for the NAAD suya frame. Keep geometry simple and material tiling clean.
Freestanding hand-painted Nigerian suya menu board, blank or placeholder text surface so localized game text can be rendered separately.
Small reusable set of metal spice tins and bowls for a suya preparation counter, separate meshes where practical.
Pair of practical stainless-steel grilling tongs, clean silhouette, realistic handheld scale.
Low-cost charcoal ember bed insert for the existing NAAD grill. Mesh/material asset only; smoke and glow effects remain Unity particle/material systems.
Single Nigerian-style plastic monobloc chair, durable everyday form, real-world dimensions, low-poly mobile-ready geometry.
Reusable serving plate with suya skewers, sliced onions and tomatoes as a static food presentation prop. No brand marks or legible generated text.
